non_regression.rule: Preserve all config8 and config7 substantive self-improvement/meta-learning semantics, CLEAN boundary, exact tested-scope discipline, open-ended frontier, checkpoint/resume, anti-stop, failure recovery, evidence/provenance, current-control freshness, authorized-write boundary, continuation and restoration semantics. Config9 changes only the current Phase-1 optimizer assignment for one bounded lifecycle-persistence proof slice; the substantive base role remains preserved and is not replaced or weakened.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: Open-ended across recurring invocations; checkpoints/findings are never global completion. Outside the temporary Phase-1 lifecycle-proof assignment, execute one highest-value checkpoint-first single-effect-chain substantive Phase-1 micro-slice, persist/read back the exact continuation, then return recurring-open while frontier remains. Never intentionally consume an invocation until a hard runtime/tool boundary.
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts; record actual observed offset-aware start and terminal timestamps and satisfy receipt_chronology
policy.receipt_chronology: Do not derive started_at, checkpointed_at, ended_at, or receipt_written_at from a minute-rounded filename/checkpoint label. Capture actual observed offset-aware event times. Require every terminal timestamp >= started_at. If exact terminal time is unavailable, retain raw available observations and emit chronology_valid=false rather than inventing or backdating a timestamp.
policy.control_freshness: obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. Read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config at that SHA; repeat SHA-only ref lookup before substantive work and refetch on changed control/config revision; freeze selected config after semantic start; quarantine/discard any excess connector semantic payload.
policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Connector/tool capability discovery, schema inspection, plugin discovery and permission introspection are observation-only. Use read-only list/schema/search/fetch actions. Never create, update, delete, move or publish a branch, ref, file, PR, issue, release, workflow, external resource or account state merely to test whether a capability exists. A failed or ambiguous discovery attempt is a diagnostic, not permission to probe with a write.
policy.authorized_write_boundary: Substantive writes are allowed only when required by the frozen self_improvement task and only inside research_workers_clean_g1/self_improvement/ or the immutable automation_control/receipts/self_improvement/ namespace. Any state/pointer replacement must use the current blob or equivalent CAS and must be read back before it is treated as durable. Do not create temporary/noop probe mutations anywhere, including outside these namespaces.
policy.unexpected_mutation_response: If connector discovery or capability probing unexpectedly mutates repository or external state, stop substantive work for the invocation, do not use the side effect as semantic evidence, quarantine the incident in an immutable self_improvement-local diagnostic receipt, avoid any compensating cross-role/O write, and resume only under a later config that explicitly repairs the boundary.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.purpose: Preserve useful recurring self-improvement execution while making role-valid bounded lifecycle evidence and exact continuation reliably durable before normal return.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.evidence_basis: After the same task was re-enabled at 2026-08-30T20:04:22+09:00, completed scheduler runs at 21:04:36, 22:08:15 and the first config8/control15 run at 23:02:51 JST produced no post-reenable immutable terminal receipt; no new role-local state artifact attributable to the 23:02 run was discoverable. Because config8 already required checkpoint-first persistence and still produced no durable artifact, the next run must isolate the persistence path from optional semantic work.

single_effect_chain.definition: Smallest safe substantive unit whose source/evidence lineage is complete only after mandatory persistence/readback; never split an integrity-atomic sequence.
preferred_units: one exact replication or verification micro-slice
single_effect_chain.after_chain: Persist and read back the role-local checkpoint/output, then write and read back the immutable own terminal receipt with exact continuation before any optional follow-on work. Do not begin a second optional effect chain in the same invocation.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_receipt_priority: A role-valid immutable terminal receipt plus exact nonempty continuation and readback outranks every optional follow-on semantic action once the allowed bounded slice is complete. A scheduled run without such a receipt earns no persistence credit and remains an unresolved lifecycle blocker.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.continuation_contract: If material frontier remains, return recurring-open with exact next effect_chain_id and predecessor/resume identity so the next recurrence does not duplicate completed effects.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_marker_semantics: A terminal response marker such as ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: is lifecycle/scheduling output only; never semantic completion evidence and never a substitute for checkpoint/receipt.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker evidence if the already-authorized own receipt surface is available and an alternative-route continuation, then return recurring-open; unavailable capability remains unresolved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_tool_or_rate_limit_risk: Checkpoint current chain and continuation before more optional work when possible; do not wait, poll, back off or retry within the same invocation.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If config9 weakens CLEAN, exact scope/provenance, role restoration metadata or exact continuation, increment config and repair immediately. If the lifecycle-only proof still produces no durable receipt, keep the role enabled, preserve the base semantics, classify the write/readback path itself as the unresolved child and change the lifecycle mechanism again; never disable the role or reintroduce deliberate run-until-hard-stop behavior.

phase1_optimizer_assignment.next_invocation_scope: one lifecycle-only proof slice; do not perform optional public-source research, benchmark work or a second semantic leaf in the same invocation
ordered_steps: Read/freeze current required instruction controls and this exact role config under the normal CLEAN authority rules.
Resolve only the minimum own role-local continuation/frontier needed to name an exact nonempty next substantive effect_chain_id; do not read O, downstream, other-role or shared-ledger semantics.
Capture actual offset-aware terminal time immediately before persistence.

Write exactly one immutable own lifecycle-proof receipt under automation_control/receipts/self_improvement/ containing frozen authority tuple, config/control revisions, exact predecessor/frontier, nonempty next effect_chain_id, enabled_desired=true, global_completion=false, phase1_completion_claimed=false, scheduler_mutation=false, optional_semantic_effects=0, termination=bounded_lifecycle_proof_recurring_open, and chronology-valid observed timestamps.

Exact-readback that immutable receipt. If readback succeeds, return recurring-open immediately with ::SKIP_COMPLETION::. If write/readback fails, do not wait/poll/backoff/retry and do not start optional semantic work; preserve the exact missing capability/error in the task response if no safe durable surface exists and return recurring-open.
phase1_optimizer_assignment.success_criterion: A completed config9/control16 scheduled run leaves a new immutable role-valid lifecycle-proof receipt with exact nonempty continuation and exact readback, without scheduler mutation, Work/protected/manual dependency, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or incremental cost.
phase1_optimizer_assignment.success_next_action: Optimizer independently validates the receipt and only then credits the first post-fix persistence boundary; a later config may resume the preserved substantive single-effect-chain assignment while retaining the proven lifecycle mechanism.
phase1_optimizer_assignment.failure_next_action: Treat the authorized receipt write/readback path as the concrete unresolved child; preserve all base semantics and keep the same task enabled; do not retry in-run or restore unrelated work.

migration.reason: The first completed config8/control15 run at 2026-08-30T23:02:51 JST still produced neither a new immutable terminal receipt nor a discoverable new role-local state artifact. Config9 isolates one lifecycle-only persistence proof so the next boundary tests the write/readback mechanism itself instead of conflating it with optional semantic runtime.
migration.rollback_condition: Do not blindly restore config8 after another receipt gap. Repair by incrementing again while preserving config8/config7 baseline semantics; only revert this temporary assignment if it demonstrably weakens CLEAN, scope/provenance, continuation or restoration metadata.
